text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A and Stock E for gains felt satisfying, but I should judge each sale by my plan and prospects, not just by locking in a profit.","Stock D’s large gain was rewarding; I should avoid assuming a winning position must be sold simply because it has risen.","With no trades in the last three periods, I’m reminded that patience can be appropriate—but I should still review my holdings rather than trade rarely by default."]}
